timing_source: Actual recording WordBoundary; punctuation tokens have no fabricated cue

audio/ar-arrived.mp3.text: وَصَلْنَا. شَاهِدْ طَرِيقَكَ، ثُمَّ احْفَظْهُ إِنْ شِئْتَ.

audio/ar-away.mp3.text: انْتَهَتِ الْأَوَامِرُ هُنَا. هَلْ نُضِيفُ أَمْرًا أَمْ نُغَيِّرُ أَمْرًا؟

audio/ar-blocked.mp3.text: تَوَقَّفْنَا عِنْدَ حَاجِزٍ أَوْ حَافَّةٍ. أَيُّ أَمْرٍ نُغَيِّرُ؟

audio/ar-demo.mp3.text: شَاهِدْ هَذَا الْمِثَالَ. نُرَتِّبُ الْأَوَامِرَ ثُمَّ نُجَرِّبُ خُطْوَةً خُطْوَةً.

audio/ar-designer.mp3.text: اخْتَرِ الْبِدَايَةَ أَوِ الْمَقْصِدَ أَوِ الْحَاجِزَ، ثُمَّ الْمَسِ الْمُرَبَّعَ.

audio/ar-f.mp3.text: تَقَدَّمْ إِلَى الْمُرَبَّعِ التَّالِي أَمَامَ الرُّوبُوتِ.

audio/ar-hint.mp3.text: شَاهِدْ أَوَّلَ مُرَبَّعٍ لَمْ يَسِرْ كَمَا تَوَقَّعْتَ. عَدِّلْ أَمْرًا وَجَرِّبْ.

audio/ar-if.mp3.text: إِذَا كَانَ أَمَامَكَ حَاجِزٌ أَوْ حَافَّةٌ، دُرْ يَمِينًا. وَإِلَّا، تَقَدَّمْ.

audio/ar-library.mp3.text: اخْتَرْ خَرِيطَةً، ثُمَّ سَاعِدِ الرُّوبُوتَ عَلَى الْوُصُولِ.

audio/ar-plan.mp3.text: الْمَسِ الْأَوَامِرَ لِتَرْتِيبِ الطَّرِيقِ. ثُمَّ شَغِّلْ خُطْوَةً وَشَاهِدْ.

audio/ar-predict.mp3.text: كَيْفَ سَيَسِيرُ الرُّوبُوتُ؟ الْمَسِ الْمُرَبَّعَ التَّالِي لِتَرْسُمَ تَوَقُّعَكَ.

audio/ar-predictSkip.mp3.text: يُمْكِنُكَ أَنْ تَتَوَقَّعَ أَوْ تَكْتَشِفَ بِالْمُشَاهَدَةِ.

audio/ar-real.mp3.text: ضَعْ بَطَاقَاتِ الْأَوَامِرِ عَلَى طَاوِلَةٍ أَوْ فِي مَسَاحَةٍ آمِنَةٍ مَعَ الْمُرَبِّي.

audio/ar-rotation.mp3.text: مُقَدِّمَةُ الرُّوبُوتِ تَدُلُّ عَلَى اتِّجَاهِهِ. الدَّوَرَانُ يُغَيِّرُ اتِّجَاهَهُ دُونَ أَنْ يَنْتَقِلَ.

audio/ar-saved.mp3.text: حَفِظْنَا طَرِيقَكَ. يُمْكِنُكَ فَتْحُ نُسْخَةٍ وَتَجْرِبَةُ فِكْرَةٍ أُخْرَى.

audio/ar-step.mp3.text: نُجَرِّبُ أَمْرًا وَاحِدًا، ثُمَّ نَتَوَقَّفُ لِنَرَى.

audio/en-arrived.mp3.text: We arrived. Look at your route, then save it if you wish.

audio/en-away.mp3.text: The commands ended here. Could we add a command or change one?

audio/en-blocked.mp3.text: We stopped at a barrier or edge. Which command could we change?

audio/en-demo.mp3.text: Watch this separate example. Arrange the commands, then try them one step at a time.

audio/en-designer.mp3.text: Choose start, destination or barrier, then touch a square.

audio/en-erase.mp3.text: Touch a barrier to remove it.

audio/en-f.mp3.text: Move to the next square in front of the robot.

audio/en-goal-apple.mp3.text: Our destination on this map is the apple.

audio/en-goal-ball.mp3.text: Our destination on this map is the ball.

audio/en-goal-bear.mp3.text: Our destination on this map is the bear.

audio/en-goal-book.mp3.text: Our destination on this map is the book.

audio/en-goal-car.mp3.text: Our destination on this map is the car.

audio/en-goal-cat.mp3.text: Our destination on this map is the cat.

audio/en-hint.mp3.text: Look at the first square that differed from your prediction. Change a command and try again.

audio/en-if.mp3.text: If there is a barrier or edge ahead, turn right. Otherwise, move forward.

audio/en-library.mp3.text: Choose a map, then help the robot reach its destination.

audio/en-paused.mp3.text: We paused. Your route stays here so you can continue.

audio/en-plan.mp3.text: Touch commands to build the route. Then run a step and watch.

audio/en-predict.mp3.text: How will the robot travel? Touch the next square to draw your prediction.

audio/en-predictSkip.mp3.text: You can predict first or discover by watching.

audio/en-real.mp3.text: Use command cards on a table or in a safe space with your coach.

audio/en-rotation.mp3.text: The robot points in its facing direction. Turning changes its direction without changing its square.

audio/en-saved.mp3.text: We saved your route. Open a copy to try another idea.

audio/en-step.mp3.text: Try one command, then stop and look.

audio/en-wall.mp3.text: Place a barrier in an empty square.

audio/ar-touch-help.mp3.text: الْمَسِ الْمُرَبَّعَ أَمَامَ الرُّوبُوتِ، أَوِ اسْحَبْ مِنَ الرُّوبُوتِ إِلَيْهِ. لِتَغْيِيرِ اتِّجَاهِهِ، انْقُرِ الرُّوبُوتَ مَرَّتَيْنِ، أَوِ اسْتَخْدِمْ زِرَّ الدَّوَرَانِ.

audio/en-touch-help.mp3.text: Tap the square in front of the robot, or drag from the robot to it. To change direction, double tap the robot, or use a turn button.

audio/ar-touch-step.mp3.text: نَتَحَرَّكُ إِلَى مُرَبَّعٍ مُلَاصِقٍ فَقَطْ. اخْتَرِ الْمُرَبَّعَ التَّالِي أَمَامَ الرُّوبُوتِ، ثُمَّ الَّذِي يَلِيهِ.

audio/en-touch-step.mp3.text: We move to an adjacent square only. Choose the next square in front of the robot, then the next one.

audio/ar-touch-turn.mp3.text: هَذَا الْمُرَبَّعُ لَيْسَ أَمَامَ الرُّوبُوتِ. غَيِّرِ اتِّجَاهَهُ أَوَّلًا. انْقُرِ الرُّوبُوتَ مَرَّتَيْنِ لِيَدُورَ يَمِينًا، أَوِ اسْتَخْدِمْ زِرَّ الدَّوَرَانِ، ثُمَّ الْمَسِ الْمُرَبَّعَ.

audio/en-touch-turn.mp3.text: That square is not in front of the robot. Turn first. Double tap the robot to turn right, or use a turn button, then tap the square.

audio/ar-touch-rotate.mp3.text: انْقُرِ الرُّوبُوتَ مَرَّتَيْنِ بِسُرْعَةٍ لِيَدُورَ يَمِينًا فِي مَكَانِهِ. يُمْكِنُكَ أَيْضًا اسْتِخْدَامُ زِرِّ الدَّوَرَانِ.

audio/en-touch-rotate.mp3.text: Double tap the robot quickly to turn right in place. You can also use a turn button.

audio/ar-touch-wait.mp3.text: نُكْمِلُ الْأَمْرَ الْحَالِيَّ، ثُمَّ نَخْتَارُ الْخُطْوَةَ التَّالِيَةَ. يُمْكِنُكَ إِيقَافُ الْعَرْضِ لِتُكْمِلَ بِنَفْسِكَ.

audio/en-touch-wait.mp3.text: Let the current command finish, then choose the next step. You can pause the replay to continue yourself.

audio/ar-touch-limit.mp3.text: الطَّرِيقُ طَوِيلٌ. جَرِّبْ طَرِيقًا أَقْصَرَ أَوْ ابْدَأْ أَوَامِرَ جَدِيدَةً.

audio/en-touch-limit.mp3.text: The route is long. Try a shorter route or start new commands.

audio/ar-adventure-help.mp3.text: مُغَامَرَةٌ جَدِيدَةٌ! الْمَسِ الْمُرَبَّعَ أَمَامَ الرُّوبُوتِ أَوِ اسْتَخْدِمِ الْأَوَامِرَ. الصَّنَادِيقُ تُخْفِي مُفَاجَآتٍ، وَالْبِرَكُ قَدْ تُعِيدُنَا لِلْبِدَايَةِ.

audio/en-adventure-help.mp3.text: A new adventure! Tap the square in front of the robot or use commands. Boxes hide surprises, and puddles may send us back to the start.

audio/ar-box-shield.mp3.text: مُفَاجَأَةٌ! وَجَدْنَا دِرْعًا. يَحْمِينَا مِنْ بِرْكَةٍ وَاحِدَةٍ، ثُمَّ يَخْتَفِي.

audio/en-box-shield.mp3.text: Surprise! We found a shield. It protects us from one puddle, then disappears.

audio/ar-box-hop.mp3.text: مُفَاجَأَةٌ! النَّابِضُ سَاعَدَنَا عَلَى الْقَفْزِ مُرَبَّعًا إِضَافِيًّا إِلَى الْأَمَامِ.

audio/en-box-hop.mp3.text: Surprise! A spring helped us hop one extra square forward.

audio/ar-box-reset.mp3.text: هَذَا الصُّنْدُوقُ أَعَادَنَا إِلَى الْبِدَايَةِ. الصُّنْدُوقُ مَفْتُوحٌ الْآنَ، وَيُمْكِنُنَا الْمُحَاوَلَةُ مُجَدَّدًا.

audio/en-box-reset.mp3.text: This box sent us back to the start. The box is open now, and we can try again.

audio/ar-puddle-reset.mp3.text: هَذِهِ الْبِرْكَةُ أَعَادَتِ الرُّوبُوتَ إِلَى الْبِدَايَةِ. نُجَرِّبُ طَرِيقًا آخَرَ، أَوْ نَبْحَثُ عَنْ دِرْعٍ.

audio/en-puddle-reset.mp3.text: This puddle sent the robot back to the start. Try another route, or look for a shield.

audio/ar-puddle-safe.mp3.text: الدِّرْعُ حَمَانَا مِنَ الْبِرْكَةِ! اسْتَخْدَمْنَاهُ، وَنُكْمِلُ الطَّرِيقَ.

audio/en-puddle-safe.mp3.text: The shield protected us from the puddle! We used it, and can continue our route.

audio/ar-knowledge-intro.mp3.text: وَصَلْتَ! لِنَكْتَشِفْ كَيْفَ نَسْتَخْدِمُ هَذَا الشَّيْءَ فِي حَيَاتِنَا.

audio/en-knowledge-intro.mp3.text: You arrived! Let us discover how we use this in our daily life.

audio/ar-learn-book-0.mp3.text: الْكِتَابُ يَحْمِلُ صُوَرًا وَحِكَايَاتٍ. نَنْظُرُ إِلَى صُوَرِهِ وَنَسْأَلُ عَمَّا نَرَاهُ.

audio/en-learn-book-0.mp3.text: A book holds pictures and stories. We look at its pictures and ask about what we see.

audio/ar-learn-book-1.mp3.text: نَقْرَأُ مَعَ شَخْصٍ نُحِبُّهُ، وَنَتَحَدَّثُ عَنِ الْحِكَايَةِ. مَاذَا تَتَوَقَّعُ أَنْ يَحْدُثَ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ؟

audio/en-learn-book-1.mp3.text: We read with someone we love and talk about the story. What do you think will happen next?

audio/ar-learn-ball-0.mp3.text: نَلْعَبُ بِالْكُرَةِ فِي مَكَانٍ آمِنٍ. نَتَحَرَّكُ وَنُجَرِّبُ الرَّمْيَ وَالْإِمْسَاكَ.

audio/en-learn-ball-0.mp3.text: We play with a ball in a safe place. We move and practise throwing and catching.

audio/ar-learn-ball-1.mp3.text: نُمَرِّرُ الْكُرَةَ إِلَى صَدِيقٍ وَنَنْتَظِرُ دَوْرَنَا. اللَّعِبُ مَعًا يَحْتَاجُ إِلَى تَعَاوُنٍ.

audio/en-learn-ball-1.mp3.text: We pass the ball to a friend and wait for our turn. Playing together takes cooperation.

audio/ar-learn-apple-0.mp3.text: التُّفَّاحُ فَاكِهَةٌ. لِلْفَوَاكِهِ أَلْوَانٌ وَطُعُومٌ مُخْتَلِفَةٌ، وَهِيَ جُزْءٌ مِنْ طَعَامِنَا الْمُتَنَوِّعِ.

audio/en-learn-apple-0.mp3.text: An apple is a fruit. Fruits have different colours and flavours, and are part of the varied food we eat.

audio/ar-learn-apple-1.mp3.text: نَغْسِلُ التُّفَّاحَ قَبْلَ أَكْلِهِ. نَطْلُبُ مِنَ الْكَبِيرِ مُسَاعَدَتَنَا فِي تَقْطِيعِهِ وَتَجْهِيزِهِ.

audio/en-learn-apple-1.mp3.text: We wash an apple before eating it. We ask an adult to help us cut and prepare it.

audio/ar-learn-bear-0.mp3.text: هَذَا دُبٌّ مِنَ الْقُمَاشِ، وَلَيْسَ حَيَوَانًا حَقِيقِيًّا. نَلْعَبُ بِهِ وَنَبْتَكِرُ لَهُ حِكَايَةً.

audio/en-learn-bear-0.mp3.text: This is a soft toy bear, not a real animal. We play with it and invent a story for it.

audio/ar-learn-bear-1.mp3.text: يُمْكِنُنَا احْتِضَانُ لُعْبَتِنَا وَالْجُلُوسُ بِهُدُوءٍ. ثُمَّ نُعِيدُهَا إِلَى مَكَانِهَا بَعْدَ اللَّعِبِ.

audio/en-learn-bear-1.mp3.text: We can hug our toy and sit quietly. Then we put it back in its place after playing.

audio/ar-learn-cat-0.mp3.text: الْقِطَّةُ كَائِنٌ حَيٌّ. تَحْتَاجُ إِلَى مَاءٍ وَطَعَامٍ وَرِعَايَةٍ، وَلَيْسَتْ لُعْبَةً.

audio/en-learn-cat-0.mp3.text: A cat is a living animal. It needs water, food and care. It is not a toy.

audio/ar-learn-cat-1.mp3.text: نَرْعَى الْقِطَّةَ بِرِفْقٍ وَبِمُسَاعَدَةِ شَخْصٍ كَبِيرٍ. لَا نَشُدُّ ذَيْلَهَا، وَنَغْسِلُ أَيْدِيَنَا بَعْدَ اللَّعِبِ مَعَهَا.

audio/en-learn-cat-1.mp3.text: We care for a cat gently with an adult helping us. We do not pull its tail, and we wash our hands after playing with it.

audio/ar-learn-car-0.mp3.text: السَّيَّارَةُ تُسَاعِدُ النَّاسَ عَلَى الْوُصُولِ إِلَى أَمَاكِنَ مُخْتَلِفَةٍ. يَقُودُهَا شَخْصٌ كَبِيرٌ قَادِرٌ عَلَى الْقِيَادَةِ.

audio/en-learn-car-0.mp3.text: A car helps people reach different places. It is driven by an adult who can drive.

audio/ar-learn-car-1.mp3.text: يُسَاعِدُنَا الْكَبِيرُ عَلَى الْجُلُوسِ فِي مَقْعَدٍ مُنَاسِبٍ وَرَبْطِ الْحِزَامِ. نَبْقَى جَالِسِينَ حَتَّى تَتَوَقَّفَ السَّيَّارَةُ.

audio/en-learn-car-1.mp3.text: An adult helps us sit in a suitable seat and fasten the belt. We stay seated until the car stops.

audio/en-learn-banana-0.mp3.text: A banana is a fruit with a peel that we remove before eating. It can be green or yellow.

audio/en-learn-banana-1.mp3.text: On our picnic, we opened the lunch box and took a banana. After eating it, we put the peel in the rubbish bin.

audio/ar-learn-banana-1.mp3.text: فِي النُّزْهَةِ، فَتَحْنَا عُلْبَةَ الطَّعَامِ وَأَخَذْنَا مَوْزَةً. بَعْدَ أَكْلِهَا وَضَعْنَا الْقِشْرَةَ فِي سَلَّةِ الْمُهْمَلَاتِ.

audio/ar-learn-banana-0.mp3.text: الْمَوْزُ فَاكِهَةٌ لَهَا قِشْرَةٌ نَنْزِعُهَا قَبْلَ الْأَكْلِ. نَجِدُهُ أَخْضَرَ أَوْ أَصْفَرَ.

audio/en-goal-banana.mp3.text: Our destination on this map is the banana.

audio/en-learn-orange-0.mp3.text: An orange is a round fruit. Under its peel are small segments that we eat.

audio/ar-learn-orange-0.mp3.text: الْبُرْتُقَالُ فَاكِهَةٌ مُسْتَدِيرَةٌ. تَحْتَ قِشْرَتِهِ فُصُوصٌ صَغِيرَةٌ نَأْكُلُهَا.

audio/en-goal-orange.mp3.text: Our destination on this map is the orange.

audio/en-learn-orange-1.mp3.text: We brought an orange to the table. An adult helped us peel it, then we shared its segments.

audio/ar-learn-orange-1.mp3.text: أَحْضَرْنَا بُرْتُقَالَةً إِلَى الْمَائِدَةِ. سَاعَدَنَا شَخْصٌ كَبِيرٌ فِي تَقْشِيرِهَا، ثُمَّ تَقَاسَمْنَا فُصُوصَهَا.

audio/en-learn-strawberry-0.mp3.text: A strawberry is red when ripe. It has tiny dots on its surface.

audio/en-learn-strawberry-1.mp3.text: We washed the strawberries and put them on a plate. With other fruit, they made a colourful snack. Which colour can you see?

audio/ar-learn-strawberry-1.mp3.text: غَسَلْنَا الْفَرَاوِلَةَ وَوَضَعْنَاهَا فِي طَبَقٍ. صَارَتْ مَعَ الْفَوَاكِهِ الْأُخْرَى وَجْبَةً مُلَوَّنَةً. أَيَّ لَوْنٍ تَرَى؟

audio/ar-learn-strawberry-0.mp3.text: الْفَرَاوِلَةُ فَاكِهَةٌ حَمْرَاءُ عِنْدَ نُضْجِهَا. عَلَى سَطْحِهَا نُقَطٌ صَغِيرَةٌ.

audio/en-goal-strawberry.mp3.text: Our destination on this map is the strawberry.

audio/en-learn-watermelon-0.mp3.text: A watermelon is a large fruit with a thick rind. Inside is the flesh that we eat.

audio/ar-learn-watermelon-0.mp3.text: الْبِطِّيخُ فَاكِهَةٌ كَبِيرَةٌ لَهَا قِشْرَةٌ سَمِيكَةٌ. دَاخِلَهَا لُبٌّ نَأْكُلُهُ.

audio/en-goal-watermelon.mp3.text: Our destination on this map is the watermelon.

audio/en-learn-watermelon-1.mp3.text: On a warm day, an adult cut the watermelon. We put the pieces on plates and shared them with our family.

audio/ar-learn-watermelon-1.mp3.text: فِي يَوْمٍ دَافِئٍ، قَطَعَ شَخْصٌ كَبِيرٌ الْبِطِّيخَ. وَضَعْنَا الْقِطَعَ فِي الْأَطْبَاقِ وَتَقَاسَمْنَاهَا مَعَ الْعَائِلَةِ.

audio/en-learn-carrot-0.mp3.text: A carrot is a root that grows under the soil. We eat it after cleaning it, and it is often orange.

audio/en-learn-carrot-1.mp3.text: We gathered carrots to make soup. We washed them, and an adult did the cutting and cooking.

audio/ar-learn-carrot-0.mp3.text: الْجَزَرُ جَذْرٌ يَنْمُو تَحْتَ التُّرْبَةِ. نَأْكُلُهُ بَعْدَ تَنْظِيفِهِ، وَنَجِدُهُ غَالِبًا بُرْتُقَالِيًّا.

audio/ar-learn-carrot-1.mp3.text: جَمَعْنَا الْجَزَرَ لِإِعْدَادِ الْحَسَاءِ. غَسَلْنَاهُ، وَتَوَلَّى شَخْصٌ كَبِيرٌ تَقْطِيعَهُ وَطَهْيَهُ.

audio/en-goal-carrot.mp3.text: Our destination on this map is the carrot.

audio/en-learn-tomato-0.mp3.text: Tomatoes grow on a plant. We use them in salads and cooked dishes.

audio/ar-learn-tomato-0.mp3.text: الطَّمَاطِمُ تَنْمُو عَلَى نَبَاتٍ. نَسْتَخْدِمُهَا فِي السَّلَطَةِ وَفِي أَطْبَاقٍ مَطْبُوخَةٍ.

audio/en-goal-tomato.mp3.text: Our destination on this map is the tomato.

audio/en-learn-tomato-1.mp3.text: We helped prepare a salad by washing the tomatoes. An adult cut them, then we added them to the cucumber.

audio/ar-learn-tomato-1.mp3.text: سَاعَدْنَا فِي تَجْهِيزِ السَّلَطَةِ بِغَسْلِ الطَّمَاطِمِ. قَطَعَهَا شَخْصٌ كَبِيرٌ، ثُمَّ وَضَعْنَاهَا مَعَ الْخِيَارِ.

audio/en-learn-cucumber-0.mp3.text: A cucumber is usually green and long. We eat it after washing it and use it in salads.

audio/en-learn-cucumber-1.mp3.text: In the kitchen, we washed a cucumber. An adult prepared the pieces, and we put them beside the tomatoes on the plate.

audio/ar-learn-cucumber-0.mp3.text: الْخِيَارُ أَخْضَرُ وَطَوِيلٌ غَالِبًا. نَأْكُلُهُ بَعْدَ غَسْلِهِ وَنَسْتَخْدِمُهُ فِي السَّلَطَةِ.

audio/ar-learn-cucumber-1.mp3.text: فِي الْمَطْبَخِ، غَسَلْنَا الْخِيَارَ. جَهَّزَ شَخْصٌ كَبِيرٌ قِطَعَهُ، وَوَضَعْنَاهَا بِجَانِبِ الطَّمَاطِمِ فِي الطَّبَقِ.

audio/en-learn-potato-0.mp3.text: Potatoes grow under the soil. We wash and cook them before eating them.

audio/en-goal-cucumber.mp3.text: Our destination on this map is the cucumber.

audio/ar-learn-potato-0.mp3.text: الْبَطَاطِسُ تَنْمُو تَحْتَ التُّرْبَةِ. نَغْسِلُهَا وَنَطْهُوهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ نَأْكُلَهَا.

audio/en-goal-potato.mp3.text: Our destination on this map is the potatoes.

audio/en-learn-potato-1.mp3.text: We helped wash the potatoes. After an adult cooked them and they cooled, we mashed them with a spoon.

audio/ar-learn-potato-1.mp3.text: سَاعَدْنَا فِي غَسْلِ الْبَطَاطِسِ. بَعْدَ أَنْ طَهَاهَا شَخْصٌ كَبِيرٌ وَبَرَدَتْ، هَرَسْنَاهَا بِمِلْعَقَةٍ.

audio/en-learn-pepper-0.mp3.text: Peppers come in different colours. This is a sweet pepper that we use in food.

audio/en-learn-pepper-1.mp3.text: We washed the sweet pepper, and an adult prepared the pieces. Its colours brightened our salad plate.

audio/ar-learn-pepper-0.mp3.text: الْفِلْفِلُ لَهُ أَلْوَانٌ مُخْتَلِفَةٌ. هَذَا فِلْفِلٌ حُلْوٌ نَسْتَخْدِمُهُ فِي الطَّعَامِ.

audio/ar-learn-pepper-1.mp3.text: غَسَلْنَا الْفِلْفِلَ الْحُلْوَ، وَجَهَّزَ شَخْصٌ كَبِيرٌ قِطَعَهُ. أَضَافَتْ أَلْوَانُهُ بَهْجَةً إِلَى طَبَقِ السَّلَطَةِ.

audio/en-learn-cube-0.mp3.text: A block is a toy for building. We stack blocks to make shapes.

audio/en-goal-pepper.mp3.text: Our destination on this map is the pepper.

audio/ar-learn-cube-0.mp3.text: الْمُكَعَّبُ لُعْبَةٌ لِلْبِنَاءِ. نَرُصُّ الْمُكَعَّبَاتِ فَوْقَ بَعْضِهَا لِنَصْنَعَ أَشْكَالًا.

audio/en-goal-cube.mp3.text: Our destination on this map is the cube.

audio/en-learn-cube-1.mp3.text: We built a tower, but it leaned. We made its base wider and tried again. Which tower stays standing?

audio/ar-learn-cube-1.mp3.text: بَنَيْنَا بُرْجًا، لَكِنَّهُ مَالَ. وَسَّعْنَا قَاعِدَتَهُ وَجَرَّبْنَا مَرَّةً أُخْرَى. أَيُّ بُرْجٍ يَبْقَى وَاقِفًا؟

audio/en-learn-doll-1.mp3.text: We imagined the doll visiting a friend. We said hello and gave it a seat. What will it say next?

audio/en-learn-doll-0.mp3.text: A doll is a toy for making stories. We can imagine different roles and situations with it.

audio/ar-learn-doll-0.mp3.text: الدُّمْيَةُ لُعْبَةٌ نَصْنَعُ لَهَا قِصَصًا. نَسْتَطِيعُ تَخَيُّلَ أَدْوَارٍ وَمَوَاقِفَ مُخْتَلِفَةٍ مَعَهَا.

audio/ar-learn-doll-1.mp3.text: تَخَيَّلْنَا أَنَّ الدُّمْيَةَ تَزُورُ صَدِيقًا. قُلْنَا مَرْحَبًا، وَأَعْطَيْنَاهَا مَقْعَدًا. مَاذَا سَتَقُولُ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ؟

audio/en-learn-puzzle-0.mp3.text: A puzzle has pieces that fit together to make a picture. We compare their shapes and colours.

audio/en-goal-doll.mp3.text: Our destination on this map is the doll.

audio/ar-learn-puzzle-0.mp3.text: الْأُحْجِيَّةُ لُعْبَةٌ مِنْ قِطَعٍ تَجْتَمِعُ لِتُكَوِّنَ صُورَةً. نُقَارِنُ أَشْكَالَهَا وَأَلْوَانَهَا.

audio/en-goal-puzzle.mp3.text: Our destination on this map is the puzzle.

audio/en-learn-puzzle-1.mp3.text: The piece did not fit. We turned it and looked for a matching edge, and a new part of the picture appeared.

audio/ar-learn-puzzle-1.mp3.text: لَمْ تَدْخُلِ الْقِطْعَةُ فِي مَكَانِهَا. أَدَرْنَاهَا وَبَحَثْنَا عَنْ حَافَّةٍ تُنَاسِبُهَا، فَظَهَرَ جُزْءٌ جَدِيدٌ مِنَ الصُّورَةِ.

audio/en-learn-pencil-0.mp3.text: A pencil leaves a line on paper. We use it for drawing and writing.

audio/en-learn-pencil-1.mp3.text: We drew a house with a pencil. We wanted the door in another place, so we erased it and drew it again.

audio/ar-learn-pencil-0.mp3.text: الْقَلَمُ الرَّصَاصُ يَتْرُكُ خَطًّا عَلَى الْوَرَقِ. نَسْتَخْدِمُهُ لِلرَّسْمِ وَالْكِتَابَةِ.

audio/ar-learn-pencil-1.mp3.text: رَسَمْنَا بَيْتًا بِالْقَلَمِ. لَمْ يُعْجِبْنَا مَكَانُ الْبَابِ، فَمَسَحْنَاهُ وَرَسَمْنَاهُ مِنْ جَدِيدٍ.

audio/en-goal-pencil.mp3.text: Our destination on this map is the pen.

audio/en-learn-paper-0.mp3.text: Paper is a surface for drawing and writing. We can also fold it to make shapes.

audio/ar-learn-paper-0.mp3.text: الْوَرَقُ سَطْحٌ نَرْسُمُ وَنَكْتُبُ عَلَيْهِ. يُمْكِنُ أَنْ نَطْوِيَهُ لِنَصْنَعَ أَشْكَالًا.

audio/en-goal-paper.mp3.text: Our destination on this map is the paper.

audio/en-learn-paper-1.mp3.text: We folded a sheet of paper to make a card. We drew a flower on it and gave it to someone we love.

audio/ar-learn-paper-1.mp3.text: طَوَيْنَا وَرَقَةً لِنَصْنَعَ بِطَاقَةً. رَسَمْنَا عَلَيْهَا زَهْرَةً وَأَهْدَيْنَاهَا لِشَخْصٍ نُحِبُّهُ.

audio/en-learn-bag-1.mp3.text: Before leaving, we put a book and pencil in the bag. We checked it one last time, then closed it.

audio/en-learn-bag-0.mp3.text: A bag holds our things and helps us carry them. We choose what we need before going out.

audio/ar-learn-bag-1.mp3.text: قَبْلَ الذَّهَابِ، وَضَعْنَا الْكِتَابَ وَالْقَلَمَ فِي الْحَقِيبَةِ. فَحَصْنَاهَا مَرَّةً أَخِيرَةً، ثُمَّ أَغْلَقْنَاهَا.

audio/ar-learn-bag-0.mp3.text: الْحَقِيبَةُ تَجْمَعُ أَشْيَاءَنَا وَتُسَاعِدُنَا عَلَى حَمْلِهَا. نَخْتَارُ مَا نَحْتَاجُهُ قَبْلَ الْخُرُوجِ.

audio/en-goal-bag.mp3.text: Our destination on this map is the bag.

audio/en-learn-ruler-0.mp3.text: A ruler helps us draw straight lines and measure length. It has marks that we can read.

audio/ar-learn-ruler-0.mp3.text: الْمِسْطَرَةُ تُسَاعِدُنَا عَلَى رَسْمِ خَطٍّ مُسْتَقِيمٍ وَقِيَاسِ الطُّولِ. عَلَيْهَا عَلامَاتٌ نَقْرَأُهَا.

audio/en-goal-ruler.mp3.text: Our destination on this map is the ruler.

audio/en-learn-ruler-1.mp3.text: We wanted to draw a straight road. We held the ruler on the paper and moved the pencil along its edge.

audio/ar-learn-ruler-1.mp3.text: أَرَدْنَا رَسْمَ طَرِيقٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ. ثَبَّتْنَا الْمِسْطَرَةَ عَلَى الْوَرَقِ، وَمَرَّرْنَا الْقَلَمَ بِجَانِبِهَا.

audio/en-learn-eraser-1.mp3.text: We drew a circle that was too big. We gently erased part of it and tried a smaller circle. Mistakes help us learn.

audio/en-learn-eraser-0.mp3.text: An eraser removes pencil marks. It helps us change a drawing and correct writing.

audio/ar-learn-eraser-0.mp3.text: الْمِمْحَاةُ تُزِيلُ أَثَرَ الْقَلَمِ الرَّصَاصِ. تُسَاعِدُنَا عَلَى تَغْيِيرِ الرَّسْمِ وَتَصْحِيحِ الْكِتَابَةِ.

audio/ar-learn-eraser-1.mp3.text: رَسَمْنَا دَائِرَةً كَبِيرَةً جِدًّا. مَسَحْنَا جُزْءًا مِنْهَا بِرِفْقٍ وَجَرَّبْنَا دَائِرَةً أَصْغَرَ. الْخَطَأُ يُسَاعِدُنَا عَلَى التَّعَلُّمِ.

audio/en-goal-eraser.mp3.text: Our destination on this map is the eraser.

audio/en-learn-cup-0.mp3.text: A cup is a container we drink from. Keep it on a steady surface to prevent spills.

audio/ar-learn-cup-0.mp3.text: الْكُوبُ وَعَاءٌ نَشْرَبُ مِنْهُ. نَضَعُهُ عَلَى سَطْحٍ ثَابِتٍ كَيْ لَا يَنْسَكِبَ مَا فِيهِ.

audio/en-learn-cup-1.mp3.text: After playing, we filled a cup with water. We drank, then took it back to the kitchen to wash it.

audio/en-goal-cup.mp3.text: Our destination on this map is the cup.

audio/ar-learn-cup-1.mp3.text: بَعْدَ اللَّعِبِ، مَلَأْنَا الْكُوبَ بِالْمَاءِ. شَرِبْنَا، ثُمَّ أَعَدْنَاهُ إِلَى الْمَطْبَخِ لِغَسْلِهِ.

audio/en-learn-plate-1.mp3.text: We set the table and put out a plate for each person. After eating, we helped collect the plates.

audio/en-learn-plate-0.mp3.text: A plate holds food on the table. We use it to arrange our meal.

audio/ar-learn-plate-0.mp3.text: الطَّبَقُ يَحْمِلُ الطَّعَامَ عَلَى الْمَائِدَةِ. نَسْتَخْدِمُهُ لِنَرْتِّبَ وَجْبَتَنَا.

audio/ar-learn-plate-1.mp3.text: جَهَّزْنَا الْمَائِدَةَ، وَوَضَعْنَا طَبَقًا لِكُلِّ شَخْصٍ. بَعْدَ الْأَكْلِ، سَاعَدْنَا فِي جَمْعِ الْأَطْبَاقِ.

audio/en-goal-plate.mp3.text: Our destination on this map is the plate.

audio/en-learn-spoon-0.mp3.text: A spoon helps us eat and stir some foods. It has a handle that we hold.

audio/ar-learn-spoon-0.mp3.text: الْمِلْعَقَةُ تُسَاعِدُنَا عَلَى تَنَاوُلِ بَعْضِ الْأَطْعِمَةِ وَتَقْلِيبِهَا. لَهَا مِقْبَضٌ نُمْسِكُهُ.

audio/en-goal-spoon.mp3.text: Our destination on this map is the spoon.

audio/en-learn-spoon-1.mp3.text: We put yoghurt in a bowl and stirred it with a spoon. Then we used the spoon to eat our snack.

audio/ar-learn-spoon-1.mp3.text: وَضَعْنَا الزَّبَادِيَ فِي وَعَاءٍ، وَقَلَّبْنَاهُ بِمِلْعَقَةٍ. ثُمَّ اسْتَخْدَمْنَاهَا لِأَكْلِ وَجْبَتِنَا.

audio/en-learn-bottle-1.mp3.text: We filled our water bottle before the picnic. We closed its cap and put it in the bag.

audio/en-learn-bottle-0.mp3.text: A bottle holds liquid and has a cap that we close. A water bottle can come with us when we go out.

audio/ar-learn-bottle-1.mp3.text: مَلَأْنَا قَارُورَةَ الْمَاءِ قَبْلَ النُّزْهَةِ. أَغْلَقْنَا غِطَاءَهَا وَوَضَعْنَاهَا فِي الْحَقِيبَةِ.

audio/ar-learn-bottle-0.mp3.text: الْقَارُورَةُ تَحْفَظُ السَّائِلَ، وَلَهَا غِطَاءٌ نُغْلِقُهُ. قَارُورَةُ الْمَاءِ تُرَافِقُنَا فِي الْخُرُوجِ.

audio/en-goal-bottle.mp3.text: Our destination on this map is the bottle.

audio/en-learn-chair-0.mp3.text: A chair helps us sit. We use it at a table or while reading.

audio/ar-learn-chair-0.mp3.text: الْكُرْسِيُّ يُسَاعِدُنَا عَلَى الْجُلُوسِ. نَسْتَخْدِمُهُ عِنْدَ الْمَائِدَةِ أَوْ أَثْنَاءَ الْقِرَاءَةِ.

audio/en-goal-chair.mp3.text: Our destination on this map is the chair.

audio/en-learn-chair-1.mp3.text: We chose a steady chair for reading. We sat down and opened a book. We keep the chair legs on the floor.

audio/ar-learn-chair-1.mp3.text: اخْتَرْنَا كُرْسِيًّا ثَابِتًا لِلْقِرَاءَةِ. جَلَسْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَفَتَحْنَا الْكِتَابَ. نُبْقِي أَرْجُلَ الْكُرْسِيِّ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ.

audio/en-learn-box-1.mp3.text: After playing, we collected the blocks in a box. Our play space became tidy, and we can find them easily later.

audio/en-learn-box-0.mp3.text: A box holds things and helps us organise them. We can collect similar things inside it.

audio/ar-learn-box-1.mp3.text: بَعْدَ اللَّعِبِ، جَمَعْنَا الْمُكَعَّبَاتِ فِي صُنْدُوقٍ. صَارَ مَكَانُ اللَّعِبِ مُرَتَّبًا، وَسَنَجِدُهَا بِسُهُولَةٍ لَاحِقًا.

audio/ar-learn-box-0.mp3.text: الصُّنْدُوقُ يَحْفَظُ الْأَشْيَاءَ وَيُسَاعِدُنَا عَلَى تَرْتِيبِهَا. نَسْتَطِيعُ جَمْعَ الْأَشْيَاءِ الْمُتَشَابِهَةِ فِيهِ.

audio/en-goal-box.mp3.text: Our destination on this map is the box.

audio/en-learn-rabbit-0.mp3.text: A rabbit is an animal with long ears. It needs suitable food, water, and a safe place.

audio/ar-learn-rabbit-0.mp3.text: الْأَرْنَبُ حَيَوَانٌ لَهُ أُذُنَانِ طَوِيلَتَانِ. يَحْتَاجُ إِلَى طَعَامٍ مُنَاسِبٍ وَمَاءٍ وَمَكَانٍ آمِنٍ.

audio/en-goal-rabbit.mp3.text: Our destination on this map is the rabbit.

audio/en-learn-rabbit-1.mp3.text: We quietly watched a rabbit with an adult. We gave it space to move and did not pull its ears.

audio/ar-learn-rabbit-1.mp3.text: رَاقَبْنَا الْأَرْنَبَ بِهُدُوءٍ مَعَ شَخْصٍ كَبِيرٍ. تَرَكْنَا لَهُ مَسَاحَةً لِيَتَحَرَّكَ، وَلَمْ نَشُدَّ أُذُنَيْهِ.

audio/en-learn-bird-1.mp3.text: In the garden, we heard a bird. We stopped to watch it from a distance and left its nest untouched.

audio/en-learn-bird-0.mp3.text: A bird has feathers and a beak. Many birds fly, and we can hear their sounds around us.

audio/ar-learn-bird-0.mp3.text: الطَّائِرُ لَهُ رِيشٌ وَمِنْقَارٌ. طُيُورٌ كَثِيرَةٌ تَطِيرُ، وَنَسْمَعُ أَصْوَاتَهَا حَوْلَنَا.

audio/ar-learn-bird-1.mp3.text: فِي الْحَدِيقَةِ، سَمِعْنَا طَائِرًا. تَوَقَّفْنَا لِنَرَاهُ مِنْ بَعِيدٍ، وَتَرَكْنَا عُشَّهُ دُونَ لَمْسٍ.

audio/en-goal-bird.mp3.text: Our destination on this map is the bird.

audio/en-learn-fish-0.mp3.text: A fish lives in water. It uses its fins and tail to move.

audio/ar-learn-fish-0.mp3.text: السَّمَكَةُ تَعِيشُ فِي الْمَاءِ. تَسْتَخْدِمُ زَعَانِفَهَا وَذَيْلَهَا لِتَتَحَرَّكَ.

audio/en-goal-fish.mp3.text: Our destination on this map is the fish.

audio/en-learn-fish-1.mp3.text: We watched a fish in a tank. We noticed how it swims and did not tap the glass or take it out of the water.

audio/ar-learn-fish-1.mp3.text: شَاهَدْنَا السَّمَكَةَ فِي الْحَوْضِ. لَاحَظْنَا كَيْفَ تَسْبَحُ، وَلَمْ نَطْرُقِ الزُّجَاجَ أَوْ نُخْرِجْهَا مِنَ الْمَاءِ.

audio/en-learn-bus-1.mp3.text: We waited for the bus with an adult. We boarded after it stopped and sat in our seats.

audio/en-learn-bus-0.mp3.text: A bus carries many people together. We see it on roads and at bus stops.

audio/ar-learn-bus-0.mp3.text: الْحَافِلَةُ تَنْقُلُ أَشْخَاصًا كَثِيرِينَ مَعًا. نَرَاهَا فِي الطُّرُقِ وَعِنْدَ مَحَطَّاتِ الرُّكُوبِ.

audio/ar-learn-bus-1.mp3.text: انْتَظَرْنَا الْحَافِلَةَ مَعَ شَخْصٍ كَبِيرٍ. صَعِدْنَا بَعْدَ تَوَقُّفِهَا، وَجَلَسْنَا فِي مَقَاعِدِنَا.

audio/en-goal-bus.mp3.text: Our destination on this map is the bus.

audio/en-learn-bicycle-0.mp3.text: A bicycle has two wheels and pedals. We move the pedals to turn the wheels.

audio/ar-learn-bicycle-0.mp3.text: الدَّرَّاجَةُ لَهَا عَجَلَتَانِ وَدَوَّاسَتَانِ. نُحَرِّكُ الدَّوَّاسَتَيْنِ لِتَدُورَ الْعَجَلَاتُ.

audio/en-goal-bicycle.mp3.text: Our destination on this map is the bicycle.

audio/en-learn-bicycle-1.mp3.text: We wore a suitable helmet and practised with an adult in a safe place. We started slowly and learned to stop.

audio/ar-learn-bicycle-1.mp3.text: ارْتَدَيْنَا خُوذَةً مُنَاسِبَةً وَتَدَرَّبْنَا مَعَ شَخْصٍ كَبِيرٍ فِي مَكَانٍ آمِنٍ. بَدَأْنَا بِبُطْءٍ وَتَعَلَّمْنَا التَّوَقُّفَ.

audio/en-learn-train-1.mp3.text: At the station, we stayed beside an adult and away from the edge. We watched the train arrive with its carriages following.

audio/en-learn-train-0.mp3.text: A train travels on a track. Its connected carriages carry passengers or goods.

audio/ar-learn-train-0.mp3.text: الْقِطَارُ يَسِيرُ عَلَى سِكَّةٍ. عَرَبَاتُهُ مُتَّصِلَةٌ وَتَحْمِلُ رُكَّابًا أَوْ أَشْيَاءَ.

audio/ar-learn-train-1.mp3.text: فِي الْمَحَطَّةِ، بَقِينَا بِجَانِبِ شَخْصٍ كَبِيرٍ وَبَعِيدًا عَنِ الْحَافَّةِ. رَأَيْنَا الْقِطَارَ يَصِلُ وَعَرَبَاتِهِ تَتْبَعُهُ.

audio/en-goal-train.mp3.text: Our destination on this map is the train.

audio/en-learn-boat-0.mp3.text: A boat is a way to travel on water. We use it on a sea, river, or lake.

audio/ar-learn-boat-0.mp3.text: الْقَارِبُ وَسِيلَةٌ لِلتَّنَقُّلِ عَلَى الْمَاءِ. نَسْتَخْدِمُهُ فِي بَحْرٍ أَوْ نَهْرٍ أَوْ بُحَيْرَةٍ.

audio/en-learn-boat-1.mp3.text: We watched a boat with an adult. When boarding, we follow their instructions and wear a suitable life jacket.

audio/en-goal-boat.mp3.text: Our destination on this map is the boat.

audio/ar-learn-boat-1.mp3.text: شَاهَدْنَا الْقَارِبَ مَعَ شَخْصٍ كَبِيرٍ. عِنْدَ رُكُوبِهِ نَتَّبِعُ تَعْلِيمَاتِهِ وَنَرْتَدِي سُتْرَةَ نَجَاةٍ مُنَاسِبَةً.
